entities.summary: Simone Mosca (1492–1554) was an Italian sculptor who was born in Settignano. His sons were sculptors Francesco Mosca, called Il Moschino and Simone Simoncelli, also known as Simone Moschino (1533-1610). During the late 1520s and early 1530s Simone worked with Michelangelo on the Medici Chapel in Florence. A Venus by Francesco Moschino was described in 1782 in the Royal Palace of Turin.
